title: Split an affine etale morphism near a marked geometric fibre
statement:
Let $S$ and $U$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], let $f:U\to S$ be etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and let $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] with image $s$. There are an affine pointed etale neighbourhood $(V,\bar v)$ of $\bar s$ [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods], a nonnegative integer $n$, and a decomposition over $V$
$$U\times_S V\ \cong\ \left(\coprod_{i=1}^n V\right)\amalg W,$$
where $W\to V$ is etale. The fibre of $V\to S$ over $s$ has exactly one underlying point, the image of $\bar v$, and $W$ has no point mapping to $s$ under $W\to V\to S$. Here the fibre product is [def-pc-fibre-product], and the coproduct is the disjoint union of schemes with its evident structure morphism. In particular the $n$ copy inclusions, composed with the projection to $U$ and with $\bar v$, give a bijection $\{1,\ldots,n\}\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_S(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,U)$.

source.place: Tag 04HM, lemma-etale-etale-local-technical, applied to all points of the finite fibre; the affine and single-s-fibre-point refinement is the third paragraph of etale-cohomology.tex Tag 04HU, lemma-points-small-etale-site, after restricting S to an affine open. Fibre structure: morphisms.tex Tag 02GL, lemma-etale-over-field (2).

proof.text: An affine-source morphism is separated. An etale morphism is locally of finite type and has an open diagonal. Enumerate the finite set f^{-1}(s) using Fintype.equivFin; finiteness is Mathlib Scheme.Hom.finite_preimage_singleton, with the proved source-library instance LocallyQuasiFinite.of_etale and the affine-morphism quasi-compactness instance. This replaces the affine fibre coordinate calculation.

source.place: Tag 04HU, third proof paragraph: the affine etale fibre is finite

proof.text: Apply the existing unramified etale-local decomposition to the complete list. Obtain an etale g:T->S, t over s, a finite clopen family C_a and a clopen remainder R. Each C_a->T is a closed immersion containing t in its range; R has empty fibre over t. Reindex the finite family by Fin n.

Each C_a->T is etale, since it is an open inclusion followed by the etale pullback projection. As a closed immersion it is mono. Flatness and local finite presentation therefore make it an open immersion, by IsOpenImmersion.of_flat_of_mono.

source.place: Tag 04HM, proof: the closed-immersion pieces are open immersions

proof.text: The fibre g^{-1}(s) is discrete by the proved LocallyQuasiFinite.of_etale instance and Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isDiscrete_preimage_singleton. The definition of a discrete subspace supplies an open N with N intersect g^{-1}(s)={t}, without a separate finiteness argument. Intersect N with all finitely many ranges of C_a->T and choose an affine open B containing t inside this intersection. Thus B has only t over s and lies inside every component image.

source.place: Tag 04HU, third proof paragraph, shrinking V to a single point over s; Tag 04HM, intersection of component images

proof.text: Put P=(U times_S T) times_T B, with projections r to U times_S T and q to B. For each a lift B->T through the open immersion C_a->T, then use the pullback universal property to construct a_a:B->P with a_a q=id. Its composite with r is an open immersion, hence a_a is open. Its range is exactly r^{-1}(C_a): one implication follows from construction, and the reverse follows from injectivity of C_a->T and r. Let R' be the inverse-image open r^{-1}(R). The a_a and R' are disjoint and cover P by the original decomposition.

source.place: Tags 04HM and 04HU, restriction of the decomposition to the smaller base

proof.text: Use the scheme coproduct universal property for the disjoint open cover to obtain P isomorphic to the coproduct of n copies of B and R'. On each inclusion its structure morphism is respectively id_B or R'->P->B, so coproduct extensionality proves compatibility with q. The pullback-pasting isomorphism gives U times_S B isomorphic to P over B. The remainder morphism is etale by open inclusion and base change. If a remainder point mapped to s, its image in B would be t, contradicting the empty R-fibre over t.

source.place: Tag 04HU, third proof paragraph: restrict to V and the remainder has no point over s

proof.text: Apply the prescribed-point form of the geometric lifting theorem directly to the etale map B->S and t in B. Obtain bar_v:Spec Omega->B over bar_s with image t; the singleton fibre property is now exactly the statement using bar_v.

source.place: Tag 03PR, prescribed point lift; Tag 04HU, choice of pointed neighbourhood

proof.text: Define a_i by the displayed copy inclusion, inverse splitting isomorphism and first projection. Compatibility with the second projection and the pullback relation prove a_i f=bar_s. For injectivity, equality of a_i and a_j gives equality of their pullback lifts with fixed second projection bar_v; after the splitting isomorphism the disjoint coproduct inclusions force i=j. For surjectivity, lift any q over bar_s to the pullback using bar_v. Its unique underlying point lies in some copy of B, since lying in the remainder contradicts its empty s-fibre. The entire image is in that copy because Spec Omega has one point; lift through the open inclusion and use the structure morphism to identify this lift with bar_v. Projecting back gives q=a_i. Equiv.ofBijective supplies the required enumeration with its exact displayed values. This also handles n=0.

source.place: Tag 04HU, geometric fibre count; explicit coproduct and pullback argument

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_etale_split_neighbourhood {S U : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsAffine U] (f : U ⟶ S) [Etale f] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (bar_s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (s : S) (hs : bar_s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = s) : ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (g : V ⟶ S) (_ : IsAffine V) (_ : Etale g), ∃ (bar_v : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V), bar_v ≫ g = bar_s ∧ ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Scheme.{u}) (w : W ⟶ V) (_ : Etale w), ∃ (e : pullback f g ≅ (∐ fun _ : Fin n => V) ⨿ W), e.hom ≫ coprod.desc (Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin n => 𝟙 V)) w = pullback.snd f g ∧ (∀ x : V, g x = s ↔ x = bar_v (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) ∧ (∀ x : W, (w ≫ g) x ≠ s) ∧ ∃ (a : Fin n → (Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U)), (∀ i : Fin n, a i = bar_v ≫ Sigma.ι (fun _ : Fin n => V) i ≫ coprod.inl ≫ e.inv ≫ pullback.fst f g) ∧ ∃ (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, a i ≫ f = bar_s), ∃ (E : Fin n ≃ {q : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U // q ≫ f = bar_s}), ∀ i : Fin n, E i = ⟨a i, ha i⟩
